name: Learn to Play — Guided Start
description: A peaceful economic introduction with the regular authoritative production and research rules. Mine, manufacture, fuel a laboratory, and build a Hauler.

objectives.title: 1 · Expand Your Mining Fleet
objectives.description: Select the initial Prospector, mine Iron and Copper, unload into the Outpost, and build a second Prospector.

objectives.title: 2 · Build a Deployer
objectives.description: Mine and deliver the Deployer's required materials, then build a station-placement ship at your Outpost.

objectives.title: 3 · Start Manufacturing
objectives.description: Load a Manufacturing Plant package into a Deployer, place it, and inspect recipes for Steel Plate, Copper Wiring, and electronics.

objectives.title: 4 · Establish a Research Lab
objectives.description: Manufacture Power Regulators, Radiation Shielding, and Research Matrices. Build a second Deployer to place the Research Lab.

objectives.title: 5 · Research Advanced Industry
objectives.description: Manufacture Fuel from gases, deliver it to the Research Lab, supply the research materials, and complete Advanced Industry.

objectives.title: 6 · Unlock Cargo Pods
objectives.description: Research Logistics Engineering, then manufacture Cargo Pods for a Shipyard and your first Hauler.

objectives.title: 7 · Unlock Hauler Controls
objectives.description: Research Autonomous Logistics to unlock Logistics Control Modules. Manufacture the required sensors and navigation electronics.

objectives.title: 8 · Establish a Shipyard
objectives.description: Build and deploy the Shipyard package after manufacturing the required Cargo Pods and other industrial components.

objectives.title: 9 · Build Your First Hauler
objectives.description: Build a Hauler at the Shipyard using Cargo Pods, a Logistics Control Module, Fuel Cell Stacks, and an available loadout. You can continue normal play afterward.

objectives.title: Optional · Expand to Another System
objectives.description: When ready, open the galaxy map and expand into a second connected system. Exploration is not required for early research.

completionText: You have established mining, manufacturing, research, and logistics. Continue freely or start a custom Solo game.
failureText: Your frontier could not complete the introduction.
